perceived_vs_actual_latency.finding: Time from mission submission to first TUI lifecycle event was 0.052 ms [MEASURED]. This measurement represents event-driven acknowledgement latency and does not directly measure physical terminal rendering or human-perceived display latency.
perceived_vs_actual_latency.distinction: TUI event responsiveness (0.052 ms) is strictly distinguished from total backend execution latency (47.933 ms).
